subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode use the binding or highest-used lane for percentage and highest-usage flows while allowing nearest-reset selection only for reset-focused display?
rationale: Usage-oriented and reset-oriented semantics are both plausible, but the current patch mixes them and produces contradictory output; repository intent is needed before the final implementation is safe.

options.title: Context-specific semantics
options.body: Use binding or highest-used quotas for percentage and highest-usage flows, and nearest relevant reset only for reset-focused display.

options.title: Uniform constrained lane
options.body: Always use the exhausted or highest-used binding quota, with reset time serving only as a tie-breaker.

options.title: Uniform nearest reset
options.body: Always use the nearest relevant reset even when that differs from the lane driving provider ranking.

recommendation.title: Context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Use binding or highest-used quotas for percentage and highest-usage flows, and nearest relevant reset only for reset-focused display.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available decision owner for this user-facing automatic-selection contract.
